thread:
Dave (AE): FYI — Acme emailed legal + procurement this morning. Renewal in ~6w, quoted headline: require 99.95% P99 latency SLA in EU + dedicated capacity option. Asking for commitment timeline.
Anita (PM): Can you drop the exact ask or screenshot? Are they demanding a contract change or just an operational guarantee?
Dave (AE): Pasted from their PO: "Must have contractually-backed P99 SLA (EU region), dedicated pool + audit logs, and 30-min incident escalation channel. Failure = penalty." They said if we can't commit they'll move to competitor.
Carla (CSM): They've been on Hosted with light customization. They mentioned some burst traffic patterns during end-of-quarter analytics. They want isolation for predictability.
Ben (Eng): High level: dedicated GPU pool + regional routing + telemetry for SLA -> infra + billing + console work. If we scope minimal (reserved pool + routing + basic metrics) probably 6–10w for an MVP. Full audit-logs & legal-grade telemetry longer.
Anita (PM): Let's run a quick prioritization — RICE-ish: Reach = account at risk (large ACV) -> high. Impact = retention + reference -> very high. Confidence = moderate (we can build but timeline uncertain). Effort = high (cross-team + infra). So score skews high because churn risk.
Evan (VP Sales): Correct — this is >$3M ARR renewal and reference. We need a credible public timeline, not a vague we-can-do-it. Also want a short-term mitigation we can offer in the offer letter.
Ben (Eng): Short-term mitigation options: 1) Temporary SLA via contract + priority support (people) without full dedicated pool, 2) Soft dedicated (logical isolation via tenant pinning) + aggressive monitoring, 3) Fast-track small dedicated pool proof-of-concept (canary) for their critical flows. Each has tradeoffs.
Carla (CSM): Option 1 buys us time, but legal may push back on hard SLAs without telemetry. Option 3 seems like the strongest signal but is the most engineering-heavy.
Anita (PM): Proposed move: draft a 1-pager for execs with 1) recommended minimal scope to win renewal (what we can promise in 3w), 2) full-scope plan & ETA (8–12w), 3) risks + rollback/cost delta. I'll draft.
Dave (AE): Sales will present option 1 + provisional timeline for option 3. Need to know what we can reasonably deliver in 3w.
Ben (Eng): In 3w we can: a) stand up a small reserved pool in EU (manual config), b) enable detailed request/latency metrics ingestion to their workspace, c) provide on-call rota for incidents. Not ready for automated autoscale or billing integration.
Anita (PM): OK — label that as "short-term pledge": reserved pool (manual), elevated support, telemetry exports. We'll call it conditional: full contractual SLA once audit telemetry and autoscaling telemetry are in place (target 8–12w).
Evan (VP Sales): Good. I need a one-liner we can include in the renewal addendum and then a roadmap milestone schedule. Can you and Ben produce that by EOD?
Ben (Eng): I'll outline the engineering deliverables and dependency list. ETA EOD.
Carla (CSM): I'll coordinate a validation plan with the customer — what metrics they'll use to verify SLA. Want to avoid ambiguous language.
Anita (PM): Action items: 1) Anita: 1-pager + milestone timeline (EOD), 2) Ben: engineering dependencies + minimal workboard (EOD), 3) Carla: validation criteria draft (tomorrow morning), 4) Dave/Evan: negotiation talking points.
ops-bot: Note — created ticket PROD-4829 "Acme reserved pool & renewal pledge" assigned to eng-team, priority: high.
Dave (AE): Thanks all. If exec wants to escalate, flag me — I'll get legal looped. :thumbsup:
Anita (PM): I'll also run a quick RICE table and include an impact sensitivity (if they churn vs if they stay) so execs see the economics.
Evan (VP Sales): Please prep one slide that shows cost delta vs ARR risk.
Ben (Eng): One caution — if we enable manual reserved pools for many customers this becomes operationally heavy. Need a guardrail template. I'll propose a scoped automation plan in the same doc.
Anita (PM): Agreed. We'll aim to keep the short-term pledge narrow and instrumented.
Carla (CSM): I'll ping Acme for a quick sync after we have the 1-pager.
Dave (AE): Ping me when done, I'll coordinate with procurement.
Anita (PM): Closing loop: 1-pager publishing ETA 1802348800 (internal), will DM the doc when ready.
Ben (Eng): Added rough effort estimates to PROD-4829.
Evan (VP Sales): Great — keep this tight. Need to avoid derailing Q2 roadmap too much. :eyes:
